insights.concise_text: The paper's text mining techniques were developed for HR executives with minimum training data and experimentation, and were implemented in a PA system in a large multi-national IT company.

triple.subject: the text mining techniques
triple.object: a PA system in a large multi-national IT company

insights.concise_text: The PA system's computer-readable interaction data enables automated text-mining analysis of supervisor assessment and peer feedback text from 4528 employees in a large multi-national IT company.

triple.subject: computer-readable PA system data
triple.object: automated text-mining analysis of supervisor assessment and peer feedback text from 4528 employees

insights.concise_text: The paper's sentence classification focuses on STRENGTH, WEAKNESS and SUGGESTION, and SVM with ADWS kernel BIBREF18 produced the best results for this non-topical classification.

triple.subject: SVM with ADWS kernel BIBREF18
triple.object: other classifiers on STRENGTH, WEAKNESS and SUGGESTION sentence classification

insights.concise_text: The pattern-based unsupervised sentence classifier for STRENGTH, WEAKNESS and SUGGESTION was evaluated on the entire dataset rather than by cross-validation because it did not use training data.

triple.subject: the pattern-based unsupervised sentence classifier
triple.object: the entire dataset

insights.concise_text: After sentence classification identified STRENGTH sentences, clustering was applied to 12742 predicted STRENGTH sentences to discover broad categories among strengths.

triple.subject: clustering
triple.object: sentence classification on 12742 predicted STRENGTH sentences

insights.concise_text: Mapping sentences in the 3 classes to the 15 attributes defined by HR managers is a multi-class multi-label classification problem evaluated on dataset D2.

triple.subject: mapping sentences in the 3 classes to 15 attributes
triple.object: dataset D2

insights.concise_text: Logistic Regression classifier produced the best results for the topical classification that maps supervisor assessment sentences to predefined broad perspectives on performance.

triple.subject: Logistic Regression classifier
triple.object: other classifiers for topical classification to predefined broad perspectives on performance

insights.concise_text: The ILP-based summarization technique selects candidate phrases from peer feedback comments and was evaluated against manual summaries using ROUGE BIBREF22 unigram score over 100 employees.

triple.subject: ILP-based summarization technique
triple.object: 100 employees using ROUGE BIBREF22 unigram score

insights.concise_text: The ILP objective maximizes total importance score of selected candidate phrases while minimizing slack variables, and its summaries were comparable with other algorithms but preferred by human evaluators.

triple.subject: ILP objective function
triple.object: phrase-based summaries comparable with other algorithms and preferred by human evaluators

insights.concise_text: The 15 attributes currently used by HR are a limitation the authors plan to address by automatically discovering additional performance attributes.

triple.subject: the list of 15 attributes
triple.object: automatic discovery of additional performance attributes
